name: The Monday Signal
tagline: The week in AI and tech, filtered for marketing
heroHeadlineHtml: The week in AI and tech, filtered for marketing.
description: A weekly intelligence briefing on AI and tech news as it relates to marketing — the conversations blowing up on X and LinkedIn, ad platforms, AI search, and the tools changing how growth teams work. Every Monday.
aboutWhy: To keep the GrowthX team current on AI and tech news as it relates to marketing — so social posts, client conversations, and thought leadership stay timely, informed, and authoritative.
footerLine: The Monday Signal is a weekly AI and tech briefing for marketers, produced for the GrowthX team. Curated with AI assistance.
